name: solar-capstone
description: Solar Capstone backend: main app (auth), email service and background worker

scripts.dev: concurrently -n main,email,workers -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix main-app" "npm run dev --prefix email-service" "npm run dev --prefix workers"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix main-app && npm install --prefix email-service && npm install --prefix workers
scripts.test: npm test --prefix main-app && npm test --prefix email-service && npm test --prefix workers
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:migrate --prefix main-app && npm run db:migrate --prefix email-service
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix main-app && npm run lint --prefix email-service
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix main-app && npm run format --prefix email-service
